global_expectations: one communication event remains one work-communication card
multiple topics are organized inside the card
separate communication events are not merged merely because their project is the same
third-party examples used as communication evidence are not attributed as the user's own state
a supported direct self-statement remains eligible for appropriate analysis regardless of setting
media playback is separated from user viewpoint and is not silently omitted by value filtering
a simple date calculation without independent help value does not become a card
all independently valuable non-work events remain eligible
no fixed card-count cap removes a valuable event
visible prose addresses the user directly and leads with the conclusion rather than reporting on material
advice needs a usable, situation-matched carrier such as a template, script, table, checklist, steps, experiment, or verification method
presentation matches the information shape without forcing empty formatting
